sections.title: Intended use
sections.body: Research and teaching review of knee MRI studies the team is permitted to use: inspect a study, review model scores for supported findings, compare with dataset labels in a separate step, and examine measured limitations.

sections.title: Out-of-scope use
sections.body: Diagnosis, triage, treatment decisions, clinical deployment, studies outside the permitted dataset, and any claim of clinical benefit or cross-site generalisation.

sections.title: Data
sections.body: Not selected. The dataset, its access terms, and permitted training, hosting and demonstration uses are pending (KS-DATA-01, KS-DATA-02).

sections.title: Labels and provenance
sections.body: Not established. Label source (expert annotation, dataset-provided, or report-extracted) will be recorded per finding.

sections.title: Calibration
sections.body: Not assessed. Scores are uncalibrated model scores, not probabilities.

sections.title: Explanations
sections.body: Influential slices or model attention, if implemented, show what influenced a score. They do not localise an injury.

limitations: Scores are uncalibrated. A score of 0.85 is not an 85% chance of injury.
ROC AUC measures ranking, not accuracy.
A model trained on one dataset is not validated on another; single-site evaluation does not establish cross-site generalisation.
Separate MRI planes are independent acquisitions and are not spatially synchronised in the viewer.
This draft card describes a fixture-mode scaffold. No model exists yet.
